name: Tips Films Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Tips Films Ltd is in
 the business of film production, distribution, 
 and entertainment activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TFL is in the business of Production and Distribution of films, web-series and related content. The film library consists of super hits 
 viz. Raja Hindustani, Raaz, Race, Ajab Prem ki Ghazab Kahani, Tere Naal Love Ho Gaya, Amber Sariya, Legend of Bhagat Singh, etc. Company owns the copyrights to all these films and would monetize it appropriately in different mediums such as Satellite, OTT etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.44 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -8.36% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
